deskyard auth: sign in to a server with a login link

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] auth LINK [--name NAME]

Signs this CLI in with a login link (https://host/link#dyl_…), without a
browser: the link is used up, and the server, your username and a client
credential are saved in servers.json as for login. When the account has
exactly one environment it becomes the default. Observe-only links work in a
browser only.

Arguments:
  LINK       string      required  the whole login link, https://host/link#dyl_…

Options:
  --name NAME          local name for the server, used with -e NAME/ENV
                       (default: its host name, unless another server already
                       has it)

Prints: a confirmation with the account and environment

Examples:
  deskyard auth 'https://deskyard.example.com/link#dyl_…'

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
